verdictBasis: The cycle does what it set out to do and nothing it changed regresses. QE-R7B1-01's cause is removed: the block-choice question no longer decides before the handler, so a pain or illness report with any block choice routes CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED and proposes nothing, exactly as without the choice (j1b 16/16; j1 132 cases; j1u 122 cases with unrecognised, mixed and null choices). The rest of the delta passes its regression checks, and both MINORs and the observations are unchanged. But verifying the property this recheck states for QE-R7B1-01 ('routes CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED … whatever block choice it carries') turned up one state where it still fails: a return's re-entry week once a late report of training before the break is recorded (a sync the R7-A Founder rule 0.7 anticipates). There, R7-A's confirmation question ('confirm that interruption again') is decided in decide() before the handler, so the reason-based substitution's clinical screen never runs. With a block choice, the block-choice question is returned; without one, the confirmation question. The reference state records ASK, and the clinical dependency is lost. This is QE-R7B1-04, MAJOR, pre-existing since R7-B bound the substitution's screen (8d32f7d) under R7-A's precedence (ecd623b), and not created by R7-B.1 or its cycle. It violates SSCTR B0-C06 condition 8 on a realistic path. The request allows no further cycle, so it closes as an explicit blocker, routed.

newFindings.origin: PRE-EXISTING, not introduced by R7-B.1 or its cycle. R7-A residual authority (ecd623b, 2026-10-30) decides the late-evidence confirmation (staleReturn) before every handler except a return. R7-B (8d32f7d, 2026-10-31) put the reason-based substitution's clinical screen inside its handler. Identical on R7-B FREEZE-2 (10b26d6), R7B1-FREEZE-1 (d41df8b) and R7B1-FREEZE-2. The cycle's C1 restores parity with the no-choice review, and the no-choice review is itself non-clinical here.
newFindings.area: clinical screen first (QE-R7B1-01's property, scope item 1) x R7-A late-evidence confirmation; catalog/runtime binding B0-C06 condition 8
newFindings.summary: In a return's re-entry week, once a late report of training before the break is in the record (Founder rule 0.7: a session 'registrada/sincronizada posteriormente'), every review other than a return is answered by R7-A's confirmation question. decide() evaluates staleReturn before the handler (src/r6-adaptation.mjs:359), so exerciseSubstitution's clinical screen (:543: pain, injury or a clinical text -> CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED) never runs. A review reporting pain with an exercise gets ASK 'Training before the interruption … did not read it: confirm that interruption again', with no proposal and reference pending ASK, so the clinical dependency does not carry. With a block choice, handled is that ASK, not clinical, so the block-choice question is returned (:368), and QE-R7B1-01's property 'whatever block choice it carries' fails in this state. An illness return is unaffected: a return report skips staleReturn and its screen (:1260) routes to a human. The plan, including the exercise reported painful, stays as it is until the athlete confirms the interruption and sends the pain report again.
newFindings.authority: SSCTR record B0-C06 condition 8 ('Reason-based substitution keeps precedence over cadence but passes the clinical screen first: pain, injury, illness or a functional limitation routes CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED for the dependent scope'); the clinical-first rule QE-R7B1-01 restored; R7-A Founder rule 0.7 asks confirmation-first for the return's re-computation, not ahead of a clinical route.
newFindings.reproduction: probes/k6-stale-return-clinical.mjs (same review) and probes/k6b-stale-return-two-step.mjs (late report recorded first, then the pain report alone). Setup: GENERAL, DUMBBELLS and BENCH, FIXED, strength days 0/4. Weeks 0-1 executed and reviewed; week 2 reviewed with its day-4 strength session unreported. RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE on day 3 of week 3 (06:00Z; reasonCategory WORK; interruption days 0-2 of week 3). Then on day 4 of week 3: (a) EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION {exerciseId: an exercise ahead, reason: SKILL_MISMATCH, pain: true} carrying the late report of week 2's day-4 session, with no choice, a ladder step or an unrecognised choice; or (b) the late report alone at 05:00Z (ASK, recorded), then at 06:00Z the pain report alone. Outputs: probes/out/k6-stale-return-clinical{,-R7B1-FREEZE-1,-R7B-FREEZE-2}.json and k6b-stale-return-two-step{,-R7B1-FREEZE-1,-R7B-FREEZE-2}.json.
newFindings.expected: CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, proposal null, reference pending CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED: what the same pain report gets without the late evidence (control row 'substitution-pain-no-late'), and what an illness return gets in the same state (row 'return-illness'). The confirmation question can follow once no clinical route is taken.
newFindings.actual: R7B1-FREEZE-2. (a) No choice: ASK (confirmation question), pending ASK. Ladder step: ASK 'Block choices are made…', pending ASK. Unrecognised choice: ASK 'Some choices are not recognised…', pending ASK. (b) The pain report alone after the recorded late report: ASK (confirmation question), proposal null, pending ASK. Identical on R7B1-FREEZE-1 and R7-B FREEZE-2.
